title: The Nun’s Story
creator: Fred Zinnemann
description: Audrey Hepburn plays a Belgian doctor’s daughter who becomes a nun and a nurse in the Congo. The opening scenes, of her leaving home for the convent, were filmed in Bruges.

title: In Bruges
creator: Martin McDonagh
description: Colin Farrell and Brendan Gleeson play two hit men sent to wait in Bruges after a job goes wrong. One loves the city and the other hates it. The belfry plays a big part in the ending.

title: The Monuments Men
creator: George Clooney
description: Based on the Allied officers who tracked down art stolen by the Nazis. One of their missions is the search for the Bruges Madonna, taken from the Church of Our Lady in 1944.
